evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>

scenario_reconstruction.note: The golden scenario table lives in scripts/, which this investigation is barred from reading. The scenario was therefore reconstructed from its name plus the cached wiki data only, and the computation below is a mechanism identification of the 650.0 delta rather than a from-scratch recomputation of the absolute 5648.4.
scenario_reconstruction.'60': 60 Splinters of Wrath (the Transcendent stack option). 60 is exactly a sourced threshold in data/champions.json; data/champion-audit/batch-6.json confirms the module exposes a 0-120 splinters option.
scenario_reconstruction.'custom_order': a user-specified ability cast order (the F2/F3 optimal-event-order feature described in data/worklists/f2-task.md and f3-task.md, whose gate text notes 'cast orders change fight totals').

active: Q, 40-splinter bonus: 'Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.' -> at 60 splinters a rotation may legitimately contain TWO Dark Spheres.
W, 60-splinter bonus: 'Collecting 60 Splinters of Wrath enhances Force of Will to deal 12% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage.'
not_active_at_60: E 80-splinter (scatter angle + 70% slow — utility only, no damage)

step_2_calibrate_the_W_true_damage_row_a.conclusion: the 60-splinter bonus is 12% (+2% per 100 AP) OF Force of Will's damage, and it is true damage (unmitigated). Wiki 'Total Mixed Damage' row 78.4 = 70 + 8.4 corroborates.

step_3_can_the_60_splinter_W_true_damage.method: brute force over W rank 1-5, cast count n = 1..12, integer AP 0..2000 (stat rounding to integers is the engine convention per docs/math-foundations.md, row 'Stat rounding'), solving n*(0.12+0.0002*AP)*(W_base+0.65*AP) = 650.0 +/- 0.05
step_3_can_the_60_splinter_W_true_damage.result: only far-fetched fits: (rank1, 5 casts, AP 676) = 649.99, (rank5, 3 casts, AP 854) = 650.03, (rank3, 1 cast, AP 1845). No solution at a maxed W with 1-2 casts and a plausible AP.
step_3_can_the_60_splinter_W_true_damage.conclusion: the delta is NOT the 60-splinter true-damage row being switched on.

step_4_can_the_120_splinter_+15%_AP_caps.method: a +15% AP buff moves every AP-scaling instance: delta = 0.15 * AP * SUM(ap_ratios). Syndra's ratios are 0.70 (Q), 0.65 (W), 0.60 (E), 0.20 (R per sphere) — all multiples of 0.05.
step_4_can_the_120_splinter_+15%_AP_caps.conclusion: with an integer AP and 0.05-granular ratios the capstone can never produce a delta of exactly 650.0. The change is NOT the 120-splinter capstone leaking down to 60 splinters.

step_5_what_does_produce_exactly_650.0.solved: one additional magic-damage instance against a 0-magic-resist manual target, m(R)=100/(100+R)=1 (docs/math-foundations.md sec 2.1)
step_5_what_does_produce_exactly_650.0.most_likely: one extra Dark Sphere (Q). Two sourced mechanisms both give exactly one extra Q at 60 splinters: (a) the 40-splinter double Q charge, live at 60; (b) R's passive 'Dark Sphere's cooldown is reduced equivalent to an amount of ability haste' (10/20/30), which adds a Q cast to a cooldown-gated order. Both are cached-wiki-sourced and both are correct behaviour at 60 splinters.
step_5_what_does_produce_exactly_650.0.decimal_cross_check: both goldens end in .4 while every magic/physical instance above is integral at AP 600 (Q 650, W magic 580, E 560, R sphere 280, auto 103); the .4 tail is exactly what an even number of W casts contributes through the unmitigated true-damage row (2 * 139.2 = 278.4 at AP 600 rank 5), i.e. the 60-splinter true damage is present in BOTH the old and new values and is not what moved.

residual_uncertainty: The scenario's exact loadout (AP, ranks, target resistances, cast list) could not be read — scripts/ is out of bounds for this investigation — so the absolute 5648.4 was not recomputed end to end; the 650.0 delta was identified by exhaustive fit against the cached wiki numbers.

The fit is over-determined only up to which ability supplies the extra instance (Q at AP 600/650/700/750/800 by rank is the cleanest; E rank 5 at AP 750, W rank 3 at AP 800, or +2 R spheres at AP 825 also fit). Every one of these is a sourced damage instance that Syndra legitimately has at 60 splinters, so the direction of the verdict is unaffected.

This receipt certifies that the increase is wiki-supported and that the two candidate 'threshold bug' explanations (the 120-splinter +15% AP capstone firing at 60, or the 60-splinter true-damage row being double-counted) are arithmetically excluded. It does not exclude the possibility that the true value is higher still (i.e. that some other sourced instance remains missing from both values).
verdict_rationale: At 60 Splinters of Wrath the cached wiki grants Syndra the 40-splinter double Dark Sphere charge and the 60-splinter Force of Will true damage, and grants NOT the 100-splinter execute nor the 120-splinter +15% AP. The +650.0 move is exactly one additional unmitigated-magic damage instance (rank-5 Dark Sphere at 600 AP, 230 + 70% AP = 650.0), which is sourced behaviour at this splinter count; it is arithmetically incompatible with the +15% AP capstone leaking down (would require AP*k = 86666.67) and incompatible with the true-damage row toggling (no integer-AP fit at a plausible rank/cast count). The old value under-counts one sourced Dark Sphere; nothing in the cached wiki supports it.
